{{Quote|When you brought Nola Indervin here, she told me the corruption in her CorSec fraud division goes way up. Before her superiors kidnapped her, she'd told her CorSec partner, Lunce Targettal, about the Bonadan Contract. Now she's afraid the corrupt cops will go after Officer Targettal. Can you bring him here?|Jadam Questrel to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Lunce Targettal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Corellian Security Force]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CorSecTrooperFemaleTemplate.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Randomly generated female depictions of Lunce Targettal, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Lunce Targettal was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
